5namespace GuzzleHttp\Promise;
6
7/**
8 * A task queue that executes tasks in a FIFO order.
9 *
10 * This task queue class is used to settle promises asynchronously and
11 * maintains a constant stack size. You can use the task queue asynchronously
12 * by calling the `run()` function of the global task queue in an event loop.
13 *
14 *     GuzzleHttp\Promise\Utils::queue()->run();
15 *
16 * @final
17 */
18class TaskQueue implements TaskQueueInterface
19{
20    use NonSerializableTrait;
21
22    private bool $enableShutdown = true;
23    /** @var list<callable(): void> */
24    private array $queue = [];
25
26    public function __construct(bool $withShutdown = true)
27    {
28        if ($withShutdown) {
29            register_shutdown_function(function (): void {
30                if ($this->enableShutdown) {
31                    // Only run the tasks if an E_ERROR didn't occur.
32                    $err = error_get_last();
33                    if (!$err || ($err['type'] ^ E_ERROR)) {
34                        $this->run();
35                    }
36                }
37            });
38        }
39    }
40
41    public function isEmpty(): bool
42    {
43        return !$this->queue;
44    }
45
46    /**
47     * @param callable(): void $task
48     */
49    public function add(callable $task): void
50    {
51        $this->queue[] = $task;
52    }
53
54    public function run(): void
55    {
56        while ($task = array_shift($this->queue)) {
57            /** @var callable(): void $task */
58            $task();
59        }
60    }
61
62    /**
63     * The task queue will be run and exhausted by default when the process
64     * exits IFF the exit is not the result of a PHP E_ERROR error.
65     *
66     * You can disable running the automatic shutdown of the queue by calling
67     * this function. If you disable the task queue shutdown process, then you
68     * MUST either run the task queue (as a result of running your event loop
69     * or manually using the run() method) or wait on each outstanding promise.
70     *
71     * Note: This shutdown will occur before any destructors are triggered.
72     */
73    public function disableShutdown(): void
74    {
75        $this->enableShutdown = false;
76    }
77}
